items.title: Hold shelf times
items.text: Holds wait 7 days at a branch and 10 days on the Bookmobile. The North Quarry locker is open 7 am – 10 pm.

items.title: Bramblebox limit raised
items.text: You can now borrow 10 e-books at a time, up from 6.

items.title: Museum passes for November
items.text: The Ossel Valley Museum and the Science Barn passes are back after the summer waitlist.
